title: Deflect the Defender
setup: The rook on f8 guards the back rank, and your queen and rook own the open d-file next to it. Deflect that guard.
hint: The guard watches d8 from the side. Give it something on that square it cannot refuse.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook on f8 guards the whole eighth rank, d8 included. {{Qd8}} puts the queen on that square and dares the rook to take it.

If {{Rxd8}}, then {{Rxd8#}}: the guard has left, and the pawns on f7, g7 and h7 seal the king in. Black does better to decline with a pawn move that gives the king air, but {{Qxf8+}} {{Kxf8}} still leaves your rook against a bare king.
